snippet.title: 『Stormlander』Open Beta Test Trailer [PC (Steam)]
snippet.description:
The open beta test has ended.

Download here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376600/Stormlander/

For details on the open beta, we'll be posting updates on Stormlander's official social media accounts, so be sure to follow us!
Discord: https://discord.gg/Ag9FZYD8bX
X: https://x.com/PlayStormlander


⚔️Stormlander Product Overview⚔️

Welcome to the ultimate siege warfare! The storm-tossed battlefield awaits you!
Slash with swords, hurl spells, and break through enemy lines with your legions.
Stormlander is a fantasy competitive action game where strategy, shooting, and melee combat swirl together—
a whirlwind of all things war.
Victory hinges solely on strategy, your skill, and your unyielding fighting spirit!


⚒️Product Information

Title: Stormlander
Genre: Online Multiplayer Action
Platform: PC (Steam)
Planning and Development: Toylogic Inc.

#Stormlander
